Advertisement for Guest Faculty
Applications are invited for Two posts of Guest Faculty (Assistant Professor in Physical
Anthropology) in the Department of Anthropology, Panjab University, Chandigarh to be filled
purely on temporary basis, for the academic session 2023-2024 (July to December, 2023).
The post is on contract basis for only academic session (July to December, 2023) at the emoluments
applicable as per Panjab University rules.
Qualifications for the post of Guest Faculty in Anthropology:
Essential qualification
i. Good academic record with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/Physical Handicapped) or an
equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed at the Master’s Degree
level i.e. M.Sc. in Physical Anthropology from an Indian University or an equivalent degree
from an accredited foreign university as per Panjab University and UGC guidelines.
ii. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National
Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR, ICMR.
iii. The candidates, who are, or have been awarded Ph. D Degree in accordance with the
University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of Ph. D
Degree) Regulations, 2009, shall be exempted from the requirement of the minimum
eligibility condition of NET/SLET/SET.
Desirable Qualifications: Ph. D. in Anthropology with good research publication record and
teaching experience in the concerned field.
Applications must reach at anthro@pu.ac.in within 10 (ten) days from date of publication with
following details:
1. The candidate must fill the following application form along with the self-attested
documents/proofs and send the same to the undersigned. (Bring the original documents at the
time of interview):
UGC regulation 2018 from (https://froms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicaionformasperugeregulation2018.pdf?174404341721).
2. Teaching/Research experience
3. Research publications
